sloka: शस्त्राणि शरपत्राणि समिधो ऽथ विभीतकाः।लोहितानि च वासांसि स्रुवं कार्ष्णायसं तथा ।। ६.७३.१९ ।।
transliteration: śastrāṇi śarapatrāṇi samidho 'tha vibhītakāḥ।lohitāni ca vāsāṁsi sruvaṁ kārṣṇāyasaṁ tathā ।। 6.73.19 ।।

translations.english: Then Lanka shone like the Sun in the sky with Indrajith who was effulgent like the Sun and matchless in valour shone.
